title: Wise Words
subtitle: WITH MARCO REYES  ·  STORY NIGHT

segments.head: TONIGHT: GLORIA RUNS
segments.author: Wise Words
lines: Good evening, everyone.
I'm Marco Reyes, and this is Wise Words.
Tonight's story is about Gloria, a dental office receptionist from Omaha, Nebraska.
She was fifty-seven, and she had never run anywhere in her life.
Not for a bus. Not for a sale. Not even from a bee.

segments.head: CHAPTER 1: THE CHECKUP
segments.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
lines: In January, her doctor looked at her blood pressure and frowned. Gloria, you need to move more.
She laughed. Then she saw a poster on his wall, from the writer Ralph Waldo Emerson:
The first wealth is health.
That night, Gloria bought her first pair of real sneakers.

segments.head: CHAPTER 2: THE MAILBOX
segments.quote: Walking is the best possible exercise. Habituate yourself to walk very far.
segments.author: Thomas Jefferson
lines: Her first walk was to the mailbox and back. She needed a nap after.
Her husband Ray, who reads history books in the bathtub, read her a letter from Thomas Jefferson:
Walking is the best possible exercise. Habituate yourself to walk very far.
Habituate? said Gloria. Fine. One more block every day.
By March, she was walking two miles.

segments.head: CHAPTER 3: THE DARE
segments.quote: It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare, it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
segments.author: Seneca
lines: Then her coworker Bev dared her to sign up for the Fourth of July five K.
Gloria said no. Running was for skinny people in tiny shorts.
So Bev taped a note to her screen, from Seneca, a Roman thinker:
It is not because things are difficult that we do not dare, it is because we do not dare that they are difficult.
Gloria sighed, and signed up before lunch.

segments.head: CHAPTER 4: THE GARDEN HOSE
segments.quote: Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
segments.author: Samuel Beckett
lines: Her first real jog lasted forty seconds. Then she tripped over a garden hose, right into the neighbor's tulips.
Ray helped her up, and quoted the Irish writer Samuel Beckett:
Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
So the next morning, she failed better. She made it to the corner.

segments.head: CHAPTER 5: THE STUCK WEEKS
segments.quote: Great works are performed not by strength, but perseverance.
segments.author: Samuel Johnson
lines: In May, she got stuck. It rained for two weeks, and her knees made new noises.
Then she noticed a line framed above the dentist chair, from the English writer Samuel Johnson:
Great works are performed not by strength, but perseverance.
So she stopped waiting to feel strong. Rain or shine, she showed up at six every morning.

segments.head: CHAPTER 6: RACE DAY
segments.quote: Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
segments.author: Mahatma Gandhi
lines: Race day was ninety-one degrees. By mile two, a man in a hot dog costume passed her.
Then she read what Ray had written on her water bottle, from Mahatma Gandhi:
Strength does not come from physical capacity. It comes from an indomitable will.
Gloria kept going. Bev and Ray screamed at the finish line, and she crossed it smiling.

segments.head: THAT'S TONIGHT'S STORY
segments.quote: Health first. Walk far. Dare. Fail better. Show up. Keep going.
segments.author: Marco Reyes
lines: That's tonight's story.
Put health first. Walk farther. Dare. Fail better. Show up. Keep going.
Me? I ran once, in nineteen eighty-one. After an ice cream truck.
I'm Marco Reyes. Good night.
